description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing product reviews in a React/Redux e-commerce application. It includes functions for fetching, adding, approving, rejecting, and deleting reviews, as well as handling review form state and computing review summaries.

methods.name: reviewChange
methods.description: Creates an action to update the review form data with a new value.

methods.name: fetchReviews
methods.description: Fetches a list of reviews with pagination, updates Redux store with reviews and filter info.

methods.name: approveReview
methods.description: Sends a request to approve a specific review by ID and refreshes the reviews list.

methods.name: rejectReview
methods.description: Sends a request to reject a specific review by ID and refreshes the reviews list.

methods.name: deleteReview
methods.description: Deletes a review by ID, shows success notification, and updates the store.

methods.name: fetchProductReviews
methods.description: Fetches reviews for a specific product identified by slug, and updates review summaries.

methods.name: addProductReview
methods.description: Validates and submits a new product review, then refreshes product reviews.

methods.name: getProductReviewsSummary
methods.description: Calculates review statistics such as rating distribution and totals from a list of reviews.
